notes.title: End of 2023 Update
notes.content:
Hello survivors 

The year is coming to an end and we are of course still busy preparing the Closed Alpha version of REBORN Survival. 

Of course, we were not idle during the Christmas season and added a few little things and fixed a few things. 

This is just a small update, but you might still find it interesting. 

[h2]Flashlight equipment
[/h2]

We have decided against a flashlight that has to be held. Flashlights now have an equipment slot. This means that you can easily equip them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/8aaa20d6baf14b6618d3991f3506624f60adb93e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/659002dde52a49220cfd1d423a93a53a6f6cbc6f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/48b0855de5517f766e893fd1a76bca4ec9496ff2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Rain & Snow[/h2]

The world reacts to weather conditions.
This means that rain & snow influence the landscape. 
Snow, for example, remains in place and changes the appearance of the entire map

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/ca5421b1faa602ce2980ae84700c43319a3dd4ab.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/5d1d2a63c2299fc22a04d8f908a71ba7a43c4699.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/85b6fc2ffd0f04bcdd2a9244b525137ec8935bce.jpg[/img]

[h2]
Impulse on last hit[/h2]

Killing zombies should be fun and feel satisfying. That's why we've added the new blood effects and a kind of impulse. Depending on the type of weapon, zombies and other enemy types are thrown backwards a little.

Of course, this varies from weapon to weapon. Accordingly, it is much more impulsive at close range with a shotgun than with a pistol, for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/6538f87ef7ae77cecb2753bfcd9ba04357a0e15a.gif[/img]

More updates to follow, of course! 

We wish you a Merry Christmas with your families and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Update News - December 2023
notes.content:
Dear Community 

A lot has happened at REBORN: Survival over the last few months. 
We have invested an incredible amount of time and have a lot of new things to show. 

We are still a long way from showing the perfect game.
And that will probably never be the case. Nevertheless, we are more than happy with the progress and can't wait to enter the world of REBORN together with you. 

If you don't want to miss any news, screenshots or general discussions it would be advisable to join our Discord. You can do this here : 

[url=https://discord.gg/3uSjQJQ4vb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/e025decb03c3b3c41583c2deca94d6272dc2dc5d.png[/img][/url]

There are now also more regular videos on our YouTube channel about the progress of the development. 
We look forward to your subscription there too.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@PixelCatGames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/de196024837bce6813b306225b7603b250cb47c8.png[/img][/url]

But now to the news 

Our map designer is working tirelessly on "Colorado". 
We have decided to open a section of the map for the closed alpha phase. Accordingly, not the whole map will be playable at once. This gives us time and takes the pressure of completion off. This allows us to put much more love into the details. The first location is the "Norad Military Base"

[h2]"Norad Military Base" Location[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/7c1eb718270d9907f56f5774d9cd18ca345435cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/b51bb155748dc7e8b6e216d9c339f6fae4614c89.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/95e5c22b8f791b08322755f1d10dbcc23956117e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/1726f8e191a98fb8859ae346a00d1135f89dfeda.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/b7f227b6b9d7284407bc3acbbaf14dfc108ea83b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/140aa6e6dbd9b84d193943c7a1aed047245d8b2b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/c81092d94cbb83238da42cc1877cb246b3421700.jpg[/img]


There are also other small locations, but they are not worth mentioning at the moment. Nevertheless, we don't want to withhold the screenshots from you. 

The next larger location will be a residential area. Work is already underway on this. Screenshots will be coming soon! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/c556c6e60b80679af964cc81950f838fce3cbc10.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/044d45793b957bb12fae8061e47832d82890f78e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/e65b8803a173279c33e76bea1aeb8c557b5d8afc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/f1f87b0b34e993d079747d8daa709ea9a6200d68.png[/img]


[h2]New blood effects & decals[/h2]

New blood effects & decals have also been added. We want killing zombies to be fun and look good too. 
We are very happy with the result and hope you like it just as much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/a7aebb0d73a04753d599e4c1a63fe16f0c34240f.gif[/img]


[h2]Don't feel like running? Drive![/h2]

One feature the community wanted was vehicles. I can tell you, it's not easy to create working vehicles that also feel good. But we think we are going in the right direction. They feel good but are not yet perfect. We will put more work into vehicles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/59e52df1dedd04ace72c6e92bb60e502a6be4a5d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/65488b1e32e7423673be591c4980e52b82f51739.gif[/img]

[h2]Airdrops[/h2]

Airdrops were another feature requested by the community. These can be called via a flare. However, they will also appear on the map at random times. 

These airdrops contain items in military quality but also items that are only available in airdrops. This should make it more interesting to claim a contested airdrop for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/c2632d0c0a5d17aa82bf2bf5bda4aad8f2bfb5b7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/bf22ceb30b5ebb4c9524f79e13ccd90350d6e054.gif[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life - Loot all[/h2]

A small quality of life function is the "loot all" feature. This gives you a kind of quick loot function. This means that all items from a container or a corpse are transferred directly to your inventory. As long as you have the space for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/21c674e55b836964bf22849dda392fee0e5d63dc.gif[/img]

[h2]Special zombie types[/h2]

We are in the process of adding more zombie types. These will of course be less present than normal zombies. But more often in more dangerous places. 

Among them is the sprinter zombie. 
It has slightly more health points than normal zombies, is just as fast as the player character when sprinting and strikes faster. 

This is also still a work in progress, but it is our 2nd special zombie alongside the Heavy Zombie.

[previewyoutube=D5MR-ZcOq7o;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, we are working on all fronts.
We hope you like what you see because we are proud of the progress we have made over the last few months. 

As mentioned above, we can't wait to give you access. This should be in the foreseeable future. 

Many thanks to the people who are supporting us. It means the world to us.


SKIVA
PixelCat Games

notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign & Roadmap
notes.content:
Dear Survivalists and Adventurers,

We are thrilled to announce today that REBORN Survival has officially launched a Kickstarter campaign! This campaign is a crucial step on our journey to create an outstanding survival adventure, and we are grateful for any help we can get from our amazing community.

[h2]Why Kickstarter?[/h2]

The development of REBORN Survival is an ambitious endeavor, and we firmly believe that Kickstarter is the perfect platform to garner the support and resources we need to take the game to the next level. With your help, we can:

Expand and refine the game world even further to provide you with a more captivating experience.
Add new features, mechanics, and challenges to make the game even more exciting.
Elevate the graphics, soundtrack, and animations to a higher standard to enhance immersion.
Expand our development and testing capabilities to ensure a smooth gaming experience.
How can you help?

You can support us on Kickstarter by becoming part of our community, sharing our campaign, and bringing attention to our project among your friends and family. There will be fantastic rewards and exclusive offers for our supporters, including digital extras, limited collector's items, and much more.
[h2]
Every contribution counts![/h2]

Whether you make a small contribution or generously support us, every contribution counts and brings us closer to our goal of making REBORN Survival a unique and unforgettable game. We are overwhelmed by the support we've received so far and are determined to reward your trust.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelcatgames/reborn-survival-2

[h2]Stay Informed![/h2]

Follow us on Kickstarter and our social media channels to stay updated and prepare to immerse yourself in the world of REBORN Survival. Together, we can embark on this exciting journey and create an unforgettable gaming experience.

https://discord.gg/3uSjQJQ4vb

https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCL5NiNCWkrdYJcmQKO-rbjg

Thank you for your support and for joining us on this thrilling adventure. Let's bring REBORN Survival to life together!

With heartfelt thanks

SKIVA
PixelCat Games

notes.title: Update News 23.09.2023
notes.content:
Dear community

For a long time we have not heard anything about the development status of REBORN:Survival here on Steam. However, this does not mean that there is no news. The latest information is always available on our Discord server. 

So if you are interested in the latest pictures, updates and polls. Join our official Discord server. This is the best way for us to communicate with you. Also subscribe to our youtube channel so you wont miss anything. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCL5NiNCWkrdYJcmQKO-rbjg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/de196024837bce6813b306225b7603b250cb47c8.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/3uSjQJQ4vb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/e025decb03c3b3c41583c2deca94d6272dc2dc5d.png[/img][/url]


[h1]But now more about our current state...[/h1]

We have been working on the weapons and animations. As you can see in our new screenshots. It was especially important to me that the gunplay feels good. No matter if against players or against the AI.
We are still not 100% satisfied, but we are on the right track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/0345480f572c630ad6fec07d2dc1da41ebef7997.gif[/img]


I had already uploaded a video on Youtube a few months ago. This video should show how zombies react to shots. For example, that they are pushed back. Depending on which part of the body you shoot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/82f29c77558c61e1e8d0f96b65491770f85b24a6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/c3303bf5682fdcb1e654911f6b558bd71f249208.gif[/img]

We believe that these reactions make battles feel even more satisfying. The shooting reactions differ from weapon to weapon. Whether small or large caliber. The same is true for melee weapons.

[h1]Skillsystem & Progression [/h1]

We have also started to implement the skills system. This should provide a kind of character progression without being unfair for other players. 

This includes things like: stamina consumption, food consumption, drink consumption, melee damage as well as increasing the maximum weight the character can carry. Crafting and trading skills are also planned. More about this later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/4ed6ccc1a523a08b44d58f4e766b61dd2424f795.gif[/img]


[h1]Colorado & Lighting 
[/h1]
Some map work may not be missing, of course. We have worked a lot on the lighting and are more than satisfied with it. It looks very inviting to us and we hope you see it the same way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/12b8a4192eb374b95293a21491313df996d85399.gif[/img]


Also "once again" a new main menu was worked on. In the meantime we are satisfied with it. But there will be some changes in the course of time. 

A new feature is that REBORN:Survival will support Nvidia DLSS & AMD FSR3 from BETA release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/bf2229a2de46039caf9551f400ef073ff36c462f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/7db9e3fad457392d2b6f2746acda6cf429f5b818.jpg[/img]


We hope you like the new features and look forward to sharing more news with you! 

SKIVA
PixelCat Games

notes.title: Update News 27.02.2023
notes.content:
Hello dear players

It was quiet around the development of REBORN for a long time. 
I can promise you that we are still working on REBORN. 

Many things have been adapted, changed and overhauled. 
I would like to talk to you about some things. Many things are still in an unfinished state, but give us a good basis to start and implement these features as we would like to have them.

[h1][b]Player animations / weapon animations[/b][/h1]

Most of the time was put into the weapons. We currently have 7 range weapons and 3 different melee weapons. Personally it is very important to me that firefights feel good. Of course there will be some optimization and tweaking. But we are on a very good way.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36225392/5ff6a03b538bfed27717a94fb8a96d32e83ebc74.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/bc4899de50c599a85aa5a5b0cea2a6df959a16bf.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/8ebbe7e9782d7ad7b72e7954ed5e32620a407144.gif[/img]


Among other things, we worked a lot on the First Person View. It's still not 100% finished but it gives you a first impression how the first person will look like in REBORN.

It is very important to me personally that the first person feels and looks good. There were 2 possibilities, either you go for separate first person / third person animations or you go for the "true first person method" where all first person things are basically third person animations. We chose the second method and I am actually very proud of the result.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/f59e1ebeba0da5ce5aa96ff0d4c9e36498b7c097.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/195d359937226d27534f16f82f2044212d97d1d0.gif[/img]


[h1][b]UI Rework[/b][/h1]

There is a reason why the general interface is rarely seen in video. I am absolutely dissatisfied with it. But that is changing now. Our designer has done a good job so far in this mockup. Of course, the design is based on other genre representatives. We don't want to deny that. Please keep in mind that these Item icons are just for testing purposes. The main menu got an overhaul aswell. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/e500e6a46bf41ca863d6b8ca4fd9ebf89db9bad6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36225392/c18eca7b1cceecc6f250a5a1858b48c5fe6bd1a3.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Administrator Menu[/b][/h1]

Especially for us, this feature is one of the most important. For later server owners among you, the whole thing is also advantageous. The admin menu. You not only have the opportunity to spawn items. But also to change the weather, the time and much more. 

[previewyoutube=lBNBpLyQ7RI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1][b]Final words[/b][/h1]

As you can see, I'm working hard on my game. 
All my heart goes into this project and I hope you like what you see. I still have a lot to do and there are still some problems I want to fix before release. But this is also foreseeable.

I'm preparing everything for a closed alpha at the end of April. 
For more information and footage visit our [url=https://discord.gg/3uSjQJQ4vb]Community Discord[/url] and subscribe to our Youtube channel.



With kind regards 

SKIVA
